svg.title: A flat map of a curved sheet
svg.desc: Schematic, not computed from the robot. A shaded curved sheet floats above a flat grid, its map. A straight dashed line on the map appears on the sheet as a curved route; dotted verticals join the ends of the route to their places on the map.
svg.text: A FLAT MAP OF A CURVED SHEET / SCHEMATIC
Solid: route on the sheet · dashed: the same route on the map
Route length 1.87 on the map · 2.15 on the sheet
